A.explanation: Too small by about a factor of 3 because it uses $n = 1$ instead of the given third order $n = 3$ in $d\sin\theta = n\lambda$.

B.explanation: Slightly too small because it uses the small-angle approximation $\tan\theta \approx \sin\theta \approx 0.75/3.5$ instead of the exact $\sin\theta$ from the 3.5 m and 0.75 m triangle.

C.explanation: Gives $d = 3\lambda/\sin\theta \approx 7.9 \times 10^{-6} \text{ m}$ when $\sin\theta = 0.75/\sqrt{3.5^2+0.75^2}$ is used with $\lambda = 550 \times 10^{-9} \text{ m}$.

D.explanation: Too large because it treats the 0.75 m screen distance as if $\sin\theta = 0.75/3.5$ were used incorrectly or rounds the angle effect to give $d \approx 1.0 \times 10^{-5} \text{ m}$.
